title: Universal Loss Reweighting to Balance Lesion Size Inequality in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Reweights voxel loss by inverse lesion size so each lesion carries equal total weight.
adaptation: Precomputed per-pixel weight map on merged crack instances, (median size / size)^gamma with gamma 0.5 or 1, capped at 10, applied on CE only; zero runtime cost.
min_experiment: Arm: house with inverse-size CE weights, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: component recall <20 px and >=20 px, relF1@2, crack IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill: component F1 not above house by 0.02.
evidence: Abstract not in index; mechanism from title and session-1 notes; numbers unverified.
prior_overlap: none; no size reweighting was run.
